Ingredients: Chicken: 2 large chicken breasts, sliced into bite sized pieces 2 tbsp olive oil 2 tbsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp garlic powder Salt & black pepper 2 tbsp honey 2 tbsp butter Pasta: 12 oz fettuccine Salted water for boiling Cream Sauce: 3 tbsp butter 5 cloves garlic, minced 1½ cups heavy cream 1 cup freshly grated Parmesan ½ cup mozzarella 1 tsp Cajun seasoning ½ tsp red pepper flakes Black pepper to taste Garnish: Fresh parsley Freshly grated Parmesan Cracked black pepper Chili flakes (optional) Instructions: 1. Cook the pasta until al dente and reserve ½ cup of pasta water. 2. Season the chicken with Cajun seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Sear the chicken over medium high heat until golden and caramelized. 4. Add the butter and honey, tossing until the chicken becomes glossy and lightly sticky. 5. Remove the chicken. 6. In the same skillet, melt butter and sauté the garlic until fragrant. 7. Pour in the heavy cream and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 8. Stir in Parmesan, mozzarella, Cajun seasoning, and red pepper flakes until silky smooth. 9. Add the pasta and a splash of reserved pasta water. 10. Fold in the pasta and coat everything in the creamy sauce. 11. Fold in the honey butter chicken and coat everything in the creamy sauce. 12. Top with more Parmesan, parsley, cracked black pepper, and a pinch of chili flakes. Enjoy! 😋 Save this recipe for your next dinner and tag someone who needs to make this with you! #TikTokCreatorSearchIncentive  #EasyRecipe #chickenrecipe #foodies  #DinnerIdeas

Hot Honey Garlic Chicken Tacos 🌮 Crispy, sticky, cheesy, loaded with creamy jalapeño ranch Ingredients For the Chicken: 1½ lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into small pieces 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder ½ tsp chili powder ½ tsp salt ¼ tsp black pepper For the Sticky Hot Honey Garlic Sauce: ½ cup honey 2 tbsp hot sauce 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp butter 1 tbsp soy sauce ½ tsp red pepper flakes For the Creamy Jalapeño Ranch: ½ cup ranch dressing 1 small jalapeño, finely chopped 1 tbsp lime juice 2 tbsp chopped cilantro For the Tacos: 8 small flour tortillas 1½ cups shredded Monterey Jack cheese 1 cup shredded lettuce or cabbage ½ cup diced tomatoes ¼ cup diced red onion Fresh cilantro Lime wedges Instructions 1. Season and Cook the Chicken Toss chicken with paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until deeply golden and cooked through to 165°F. 2. Make the Sticky Sauce Lower the heat slightly. Add butter and garlic to the skillet and cook for 20–30 seconds. Stir in honey, hot sauce, soy sauce, and red pepper flakes. Let it bubble for 1–2 minutes until glossy and slightly thickened. Toss the chicken until every piece is coated. 3. Mix the Jalapeño Ranch Stir together ranch, jalapeño, lime juice, and cilantro. Keep it slightly thick so the drizzle looks dramatic. 4. Crisp the Tacos Add a little Monterey Jack cheese to one side of each tortilla, top with hot honey chicken, fold, and toast in a clean skillet for 1–2 minutes per side until golden and crispy. 5. Finish Open each taco slightly and add shredded lettuce, tomatoes, and red onion. Drizzle generously with creamy jalapeño ranch and finish with cilantro and a squeeze of lime. #tiktokfood #EasyRecipe #tiktokcreatorsearchinsightsincentive #comfortfood #DinnerIdeas
